title: pm-dispatch(triage): each round reads every main and queue red since the last round record, answers `pm:retriage` on `pm:epic` cards too, and a lane can hold a head with a `Contract-review-hold:` line
body:
triage#1 · os-zhuang · session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U

**Filing gate ③** (maintainer-directed). Triage's own review of what it missed on 2026-10-28 and 10-29, offered in the triage session, and the maintainer: 「立卡」 (2026-10-29). ⛔ Not a claim. Lane `domain:skills`. Tier H (`.claude/**`).

## What happened (measured)

1. **Main red with no anchor.**
   - Push `CI` went red twice on `Test Core (5/8)`, at 2026-10-28T15:14Z (run 40713919581) and 2026-10-28T15:41Z (run 40718500281). The only annotation is `create-objectstack … pnpm run test exited (1)`.
   - Triage was stopped from about 15:10Z to 00:51Z. Its first round back read only the latest runs, so neither red got a p0 anchor (convention ①, #27047).
   - It was found by chance in the second round (R733) and folded into #27306.
2. **A `pm:retriage` on an epic waited about 10 hours.** #26709 (`pm:epic`) asked triage three questions at 2026-10-28T15:58Z. The triage sweep skips `pm:epic` cards as coordination nodes, so the request was not seen until a manual blocked-card audit on 10-29.
3. **A lane's "don't review this head yet" had no shape.**
   - On #27268 the epic PM wrote in prose that the head would move and that it would hang `needs:contract-review` after the last merge (6472451890).
   - Triage had already claimed under gap rule (b), and then had to withdraw. Free text cannot be read reliably, so the next lane hold will cause the same churn.

## Wanted

One line each, in the files that own these rules, with no new gate (「新增门禁默认否」):

1. **Read the gap, not the moment** (`references/triage-duties.md`, round steps). Each round reads **every** `main` push, schedule and merge-queue conclusion since the previous round record's fire time, not just the newest runs.
   - Any red in that window that has no anchor gets a p0 anchor now. If `main` is green again, the anchor still records the red and names the card that carries the fix.
   - A round that follows a gap (no record for over 90 minutes) says so in its record.
2. **`pm:retriage` is answered in the round it is seen, `pm:epic` included** (`references/triage-duties.md`, next to 「父单是协调节点」). An epic is never dispatched, but a question a lane or epic PM puts to triage is answered like any other card's.
3. **`Contract-review-hold:` line** (`references/contract-review.md`, beside the claim and hand-off lines of #27062):
   - Shape: `Contract-review-hold: <session> · head <sha> · <reason> · until <condition>`.
   - It is per head: a new head clears it. While a hold names the current head, gap rule (b) does not fire.
   - The lane that holds owns the review once the condition is met: it hangs `needs:contract-review` or posts a hand-off.
   - A hold older than 24 hours with the condition unmet is listed in the triage round record, so a hold cannot become a silent skip.

## Acceptance

- The three lines are in those files, and each states its rule once.
- `scripts/pm/` readers, if any parse the claim and hand-off lines (`--owed`), learn the hold line in the same PR. That is a reader of an existing list, not a new gate.

## Related

#27062 (gap rule, claim and hand-off lines) · #27047 (p0 convention ①) · #27345 / #27363 (approval gated on a PASS) · #27306 (the fsync card that now carries the 10-28 reds).
